title: LCARS Events Catalogue v1
description: Structural schema for priv/event_router/events.yaml (parsed YAML map). Exercised BOTH by events_schema_test.exs (build-time structural gate) AND by the runtime loader (Fleet.EventRouter.Catalog.load!/0) since the registry became load-bearing for ROUTING: an entry's value is either [] (unrouted - consumed by direct subscribers, documented per consumer moduledoc) or a routing object driving the classification chain (DriftMonitor/Cat5Escalator). The old tolerance for a non-empty handler-module list is GONE: the runtime never consumed it, and a schema must not announce handlers while they stay inert (audit B-05).

events.description: Map event_type -> [] (unrouted) OR routing object {source, action, cat5_source?, threshold?}. The routing is the declarative event+source -> classification/action/threshold/sink table the classification chain loads at boot.

oneOf.description: Unrouted: consumed by direct PubSub subscribers (see the consumers' moduledocs).

source.description: REQUIRED producer source (anti-spoof): the chain acts only on events carrying this source - a spoofed-source event of the type is ignored.

action.description: cat5 = escalate via Cat5Escalator (audit log + audit_cat5_<cat5_source> broadcast + coord escalation). coord_decision = route the payload's decision to the coord backend (audit-verdict mechanics). incident = recurrence-gated incident recording (IncidentConsumer; requires the incident block). incident_cat5 = direct max-severity escalation (IncidentConsumer; the tag derives from the starfleet.audit_cat5_<tag> type).

cat5_source.description: Cat-5 source tag (action=cat5 only): names the escalation and synthesizes the audit_cat5_<tag> broadcast type - which MUST itself be a registered event key (starfleet.audit_cat5_<tag>).

threshold.description: Optional gating: act only when payload[counter] >= min. Absent = act on every occurrence.

incident.description: Incident classification (action=incident only): op = the registry operation class (dedup namespace), subject = the payload key carrying the incident subject, escalate_kind = typed escalation override, forward = extra payload keys forwarded as diagnostic opts.

gate.description: The gate: immediate = durable issue on the FIRST occurrence (escalate_gated, cooldown only); recurrence (default) = first noted, recurrence escalated (record_or_escalate). immediate REQUIRES escalate_kind (closed kind table in Escalation - an unnamed kind crashes; refused at boot by the Catalog).
